STEP 1: FIND THE VIDEO 

Where to Look

Do NOT limit yourself to finance or investment content. The best viral mechanics often come from unrelated niches.

Search these categories on TikTok and Instagram every Monday:

• Personal finance (any language, any market)
• Business/entrepreneurship
• Tech/gadget reviews
• Cooking/recipes (yes, cooking teaches structure and pacing)
• Fitness/workout explainers
• Productivity/life hacks
What Qualifies as Viral

Metrics to look for:

• 500K+ views (TikTok or Instagram Reels)
• OR: 50K+ views from creator with under 10K followers (overperforming content)
• 10K+ comments (engagement indicates curiosity or debate)
• OR: High save rate visible in comments (people saying save, bookmarked, need this later)
Weekly Target

Lara finds 10-15 viral videos every Monday. Hana reviews the list Monday afternoon and selects the top 5 for deep deconstruction. By Tuesday morning, both of you have deconstructed all 5 using the template below.

STEP 3: IDENTIFY THE WINNING BRICKS

Not all 7 bricks are equally strong in every video. Your job: find the 2-3 bricks that made this video go viral.

Questions to Ask

• Which brick stopped me from scrolling? (Usually Hook or Visual Format)
• Which brick made me watch until the end? (Usually Story Structure or Angle)
• Which brick made me want to comment or share? (Usually Angle or Topic)
Example Analysis:

Viral cooking video: Why restaurant pasta tastes better

• Winning Brick 1: Hook (visual of pasta water being salted heavily + spoken: You're not using enough salt)
• Winning Brick 2: Angle (contrarian take: The secret isn't the sauce, it's the water)
• Winning Brick 3: Story Structure (myth-busting format keeps viewer engaged)
Decision: Keep these 3 bricks. Adapt them to Divido. Replace weaker bricks (audio was generic trending sound, visual format was standard talking head).

STEP 4: ADAPT TO DIVIDO'S VOICE

This is where most teams fail. They copy the viral video exactly and it feels off-brand. You must translate viral mechanics into Divido's specific voice.

Divido's Voice (Non-Negotiable Rules)

• Language: Egyptian Arabic (not MSA, not English unless targeting expats)
• Tone: Transparent, founder-led, no hype or FOMO tactics
• Data: Always include specific numbers (27% certificate rate, 40% EGP devaluation, etc.)
• Honesty: Acknowledge risks, lock-up periods, exit mechanics upfront
• CTA: Native embeds only (mention calculator, app, or email course naturally in story)
• Polarization: Include one statement designed to spark debate in comments
Translation Examples

STEP 5: WRITE THE SCRIPT (Lara) + APPROVE (Hana)

Now that you have deconstructed the viral video and adapted it to Divido's voice, Lara writes the actual script.

Script Template (60-Second TikTok)

HOOK (0-3 seconds):

• Visual: [Describe what viewer sees in first frame]
• Spoken: [First sentence - max 10 words]
• Text Overlay: [Confirm the promise]
BODY (3-50 seconds):

• Follow chosen story structure (listicle, myth-busting, comparison)
• Include specific numbers/data
• Include one polarizing statement for comments cyclone
CTA (50-60 seconds):

• Native embed (mention calculator, email course, or app naturally)
• Never say: Click link in bio, Download now, Sign up here. Instead: The free calculator shows you the exact numbers, link in bio
Hana's Approval Checklist

Before approving Lara's script, check all of these:

• □ Triple alignment present in hook (visual + spoken + text)
• □ Contrarian angle that challenges common Egyptian belief
• □ Specific numbers included (not vague claims)
• □ Script reads aloud in under 60 seconds
• □ One polarizing statement for debate
• □ CTA is native embed (not interruption)
• □ Voice sounds like Divido (transparent, founder-led, no hype)

REMEMBER

Virality is not magic. It is mechanical. Every viral video is built from 7 decisions. Your job is to identify those decisions, keep what works, replace what doesn't, and translate everything into Divido's voice.
